Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nikhil - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anita - 35 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "Nikhil, what's the plan today?"

[Nikhil tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Nikhil (surprised): "And then?"

[Nikhil scratches his head.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look at this."

[Nikhil coughs.]

Nikhil: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
